unit_rules.name: Void Illusions
unit_rules.text: During unit deployment, this unit does not need to be placed within Unit Coherency. At the start of the battle, each model in this Unit becomes its own unit.

unit_rules.name: Illusory Teleport
unit_rules.text: At the end of the Battle Round, if this unit is not within Melee Distance of an enemy, it may be placed into Reserves.
